entities.summary: Rostislav Ernstovich Goldshteyn is a Russian politician serving as Head of the Komi Republic since September 2025. He has previously served as the Governor of the Jewish Autonomous Oblast from 2019 to 2024, having served his first year in acting capacity. He is a member of the ruling United Russia party. Rostislav Goldstein was a political leaders from Selizharovo (b. 1969-03-15, Selizharovo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
